report.summary: Checkout was failing for two reasons. The payments connector was stopped, so I started it. Then the provider returned 401 because .env named the variable PAYMENT_TOKEN while app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN. I renamed the key, kept the existing value, and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests pass. The test checkout is in the provider ledger (pay_e3f13960b8) and saved in the DB, which now has 41 orders.
